records.title: Food-at-home inflation
records.summary: Retail grocery purchasing power depends on both the price level and income. Slower inflation does not reverse previous price increases.

details.methodology: 100 × (food-at-home CPI / same month one year earlier − 1); seasonally adjusted index. Inflation rate, not price level.

records.title: Food-at-home price level
records.summary: Retail grocery purchasing power depends on both the price level and income. Slower inflation does not reverse previous price increases.

details.methodology: Published government index; price level is separate from year-over-year inflation. Latest vintage; historical revisions possible.

records.title: Nitrogen fertilizer producer prices

details.methodology: Published government index; price level is separate from year-over-year inflation. Latest vintage; historical revisions possible.

records.title: Farm products producer prices
